description: This file defines a report for procurement tracking in an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, retrieve and process procurement data, and map related records such as material requests, purchase invoices, and purchase receipts.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for generating procurement tracker report, returning columns and data based on optional filters.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Defines the structure and column specifications for the report.

methods.name: get_conditions(filters)
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters for querying procurement data.

methods.name: get_data(filters)
methods.description: Fetches and compiles procurement data including material requests, purchase orders, invoices, and receipts.

methods.name: get_mapped_mr_details(conditions)
methods.description: Retrieves and maps material request and material request items data, categorizing with or without linked purchase orders.

methods.name: get_mapped_pi_records()
methods.description: Fetches purchase invoice items related to purchase orders, filtering out closed, completed, or canceled orders.

methods.name: get_mapped_pr_records()
methods.description: Retrieves purchase receipt records linked to purchase order items, excluding closed, completed, or canceled receipts.

methods.name: get_po_entries(conditions)
methods.description: Fetches purchase order and associated items based on generated conditions.
